alternative_explanations: A gain can come from a pooled nonlinear feature map rather than the update law; matched additive/delta fast-weight and independent meta-update controls isolate this.
Change-point model banks or bounded replay may recover recurring regimes without a learned update and at lower full cost.
confounds: The three synthetic mechanisms share Gaussian inputs and may reward generic regression more than real nonstationary perception.
One blind seed cannot estimate schedule or world variance, so any positive is authorization for replication only.
falsification_criteria: Kill the implementation and return HYP-0014 dormant if overall prequential accuracy is below 0.90, minimum mechanism below 0.85, worst phase below 0.75, or state exceeds the frozen boundary.

Kill the shared-update claim if shared_meta_update does not strictly beat independent_meta_update in accuracy, recovery and recurrence, or if the strongest fixed adaptive estimator matches or Pareto-dominates it after acquisition, meta-fit, every update, bytes, state and R16 workload.

invalidation_rules: Invalidate on any training and scoring seed collision.
Invalidate if prediction occurs after target reveal or future observations are accessed.
Invalidate if a non-oracle candidate receives mechanism, regime, phase or boundary information.
Invalidate on post-score tuning or evaluator-integrity change.

outcome_policy.negative: A crash rejects only that implementation; target leakage, privileged mechanism access, seed collision, state-boundary violation or evaluator digest change invalidates the affected result/cohort.
outcome_policy.null: A valid null, independent match or fixed-control dominance returns HYP-0014 dormant without learning-rate, feature-width, replay-size or threshold tuning.
outcome_policy.positive: A valid one-seed positive authorizes an unchanged three-seed adversarial schedule screen; it does not make the family promising or promoted.

predicted_outcome: The shared learned gate may improve abrupt recovery over fixed LMS, but will probably fail a mechanism or recurrence gate, match its independent ablation, or remain Pareto-dominated by change-point/kernel/replay controls; a broad positive would authorize only replication.
promotion_criteria: Quick cannot promote; only authorize a three-seed adversarial screen if every capability gate passes, shared beats independent and all fixed controls, and shared is implementably non-dominated.
research_question: Can one frozen source-identical learned local update law transfer across unseen linear, quadratic and periodic nonstationary streams with better prequential recovery and recurrence per fully charged cost than its independent ablation and the strongest fixed online estimator?
title: One shared learned fast-state update across hidden recurrent regimes
